title: Core patches
description: One switch per Stellars core patch. Every patch applies by default. A switch change applies on the next page reload.

jupyterlab_change_ui_font_size_fix.title: UI font size alignment
jupyterlab_change_ui_font_size_fix.description: Scale file browser icons with the UI font size and keep item text aligned with its icon.

jupyterlab_file_browser_column_width_fix.title: File browser column width
jupyterlab_file_browser_column_width_fix.description: Recover stale cached file browser column widths before the stock clamp turns them negative.

jupyterlab_jump_to_definition_fix.title: Jump to definition
jupyterlab_jump_to_definition_fix.description: Open the definition in the current notebook through Jedi instead of rebuilding the source view.

jupyterlab_markdown_switch_tab_scrolling.title: Markdown tab scrolling
jupyterlab_markdown_switch_tab_scrolling.description: Keep the scroll position when switching tabs while images are still loading.

jupyterlab_markdown_syntax_rendering_fix.title: Markdown syntax rendering
jupyterlab_markdown_syntax_rendering_fix.description: Apply syntax colours to fenced code blocks in rendered Markdown.

jupyterlab_markdown_viewer_toc_fix.title: Markdown viewer table of contents
jupyterlab_markdown_viewer_toc_fix.description: Make table of contents anchors work in the Markdown Viewer.

jupyterlab_other_file_type_menu_fix.title: Other file type menu
jupyterlab_other_file_type_menu_fix.description: Offer a context menu for file types with no registered viewer and avoid the LSP mimeTypes crash.

jupyterlab_restore_terminals_fix.title: Restore terminals
jupyterlab_restore_terminals_fix.description: Restore terminal working directories after a workspace restore.

jupyterlab_server_proxy_launcher_fix.title: Server proxy launcher icons
jupyterlab_server_proxy_launcher_fix.description: Render SVG icons of server-proxy launchers in custom categories.

jupyterlab_terminal_cpr_escape_fix.title: Terminal CPR escape
jupyterlab_terminal_cpr_escape_fix.description: Filter CPR escape text from idle terminal output.

redrawBackgroundTerminals.title: Redraw background terminals
redrawBackgroundTerminals.description: Redraw a background terminal at its real size when its tab is first shown. Applies only when the terminal CPR patch is on.
